title: Coherent Heterogeneous SoC
alt: Flat system architecture of CPU and NPU clusters feeding a coherent fabric, shared LLC and DRAM controller, with separate host ingress and external memory.
strengths: CPU and NPU are clearly parallel clients, with private cache ownership and shared coherent fabric/LLC visible.
Straight request paths, source-backed internal ownership and external host/DRAM boundaries remain clear.
Restrained sage peers, neutral common services and pale ochre memory role create a hierarchy without rainbow coding.
limitations: This explanatory system illustration was generated in system_illustration mode after exact engineering guide attempts failed or folded too much structure; it is not a certified exact netlist rendering.
Only request-direction paths are shown; coherence response, snoop and protocol detail are outside this example.
Host I/O is placed below rather than left; the lower-right SoC area has spare space. Finishes retain slight tonal variation.
